summary.en: A chapter page of at most two questions: a window rises, each question types, its options pop in, and one is picked on a beat, filling ink and pushing in while the others step back.
summary.zh: 最多两个问题的章节页：窗口升起，每个问题敲出，选项弹出，在拍点上选中其中一个，它填成墨色并放大，其余退后。

fits: A tool that asks before it acts: the questions it asks and what the person chose.
notFor: More than two questions (split the page); options longer than two words; a tool that never asks.

intent.en: Show that the person decides: the tool asks, the person picks, on the beat.
intent.zh: 表明做决定的是人：工具提问，人在拍点上选择。

content.en: The header (title halves, note), the window's title and label, 1–2 questions (id, ≤ 5 words, 2–3 options of ≤ 2 words, the pick).
content.zh: 页眉（两半标题、注释）、窗口标题和标签、1–2 个问题（编号、≤ 14 字、2–3 个 ≤ 5 字的选项、选中项）。

fits.zh: 先问再做的工具：它问了什么、人选了什么。

notFor.zh: 超过两个问题（拆页）；超过两个词的选项；从不提问的工具。

pairs.note: the decisions after it (runtime container-morph between)

en: The pick must be a person's choice: a machine result picked on the beat reads as a person deciding.
zh: 选中的必须是人的选择：机器结果在拍点上被“选中”会被读成人在做决定。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
